---
title: "Top-level image-width and image-height accept pixel numbers"
image: square.svg
image-width: 1200
image-height: 630
_quarto:
  render-project: true
  tests:
    html:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - '<meta property="og:image" content="https://example.com/square.svg">'
        -
          - 'og:image:width'
          - 'og:image:height'
---

Top-level image-width and image-height are not read, so a numeric value must render and no og:image size is emitted.
